EGY.note: The dashboard reports ITU indicator data and states no statistics drawn from administrative records of a public body.
Only international bandwidth per internet user in kbit/s is given; no cable or fibre route is stated.

facts.fact: The ITU Digital Development Dashboard gives 72% of Egypt's population as individuals using the internet in 2022.
The ITU Digital Development Dashboard gives 97% of individuals in Egypt as owning a mobile phone in 2022.
